extensionDescription.message: Check page links and bookmarks, review HTTP statuses, and export reports as CSV.

allowLoopbackDetail.message: Lets you check localhost, 127.0.0.1 and [::1] after granting browser access. Keep this off for everyday scans.

sourceUnavailable.message: Switch to a website tab to scan its links.

captureError.message: This page could not be read. Open a regular HTTP or HTTPS page and try again.

storageError.message: The report could not be saved or loaded. Reload this tab or start a new scan.

settingsError.message: Your settings could not be saved.

openError.message: The report tab could not be opened. Try again.

noReportDetail.message: Open a website and choose Scan current page from the extension menu.

reportUnavailable.message: This saved report is no longer available.

phaseDuplicate.message: This report is running in another tab. Results will update when it finishes.

emptyLinks.message: No HTTP or HTTPS links were found on this page.

permissionDetail.message: Allow access to the listed hosts ($1) to check their links. Links without access stay unchecked.

permissionDenied.message: Access was declined. The affected links are still marked as not checked.

permissionError.message: The browser could not request access. Check the extension’s site access settings.

captureLimited.message: The page exceeded the extraction limit. Some links may be absent from this report.

reasonNetwork.message: The browser could not reach the link.

reasonRedirectHidden.message: The browser did not expose the redirect destination.

reasonInterrupted.message: The scan tab was closed or reloaded.

interruptedHint.message: Saved results are available. Select Scan to start a new check.

http429.message: The site is rate limiting requests.

selectVisible.message: Select eligible links on this page

locateUnavailable.message: The original link could not be highlighted. Reopen the source page and scan it again.

networkDisclosure.message: Checking a link sends a request to its site. The site can see your IP address and other network information.

reasonUnsafeUrl.message: Skipped because the address may contain sensitive information.

reasonDns.message: The hostname could not be verified as public.

clearReportsConfirm.message: Clear all saved reports and their results?

http400.message: The site could not understand the request.

http405.message: The site does not allow this request method.

http408.message: The server timed out while waiting for the request.

http451.message: The page is unavailable for legal reasons.

http502.message: A gateway received an invalid response from another server.

http504.message: A gateway did not receive a response in time.

consentDetail.message: Firefox asks for consent to send page links or bookmark URLs to their respective sites.
